title: Hybrid Polariton Driven Graphene-InSb Hot Carrier Thermophotovoltaics with Hyperbolic hBN Emitters
subtitle: Undergraduate Thesis Research
description: Designed a hybrid polariton driven Graphene-InSb Near-Field Thermophotovoltaic (TPV) system with hyperbolic hBN emitters. Investigated the performance analysis and the impact of graphene layers in the TPV system.
